load_status_scope: every-ID source finalized observations plus all8 slot/count and complete state/fees/balances, without per-load-ID all8 status vectors

pressure_actual_handoff_case.selection: Nearest actual lower neighbor of the even-sized population median; one case, not a sum of medians.

qualifications: Latency begins after signed transaction creation, before enqueue to the source admission job; it ends when the source processes that exact ID as finalized. It includes source queueing, transport, admission, consensus and status polling.

R30 load acceptance uses every-ID finalized observations/digests at the sources, all8 native slot/count maps and full protected state/fee/balance/background oracles. It does not provide complete every-load-ID status vectors on every validator. The607-transaction prelude has complete full64-signature archives on all8.

Resource means cover the common120-second offer for each short point and3660-second offer for the hour. Throughput includes source drain. Dividing these rates is a proxy, not an integral per-transaction cost.

Owned process CPU/RSS/physical-IO counters are distinct from whole-host network/disk/CPU/memory counters, which include the original validators and unrelated host activity. Sums of node RSS peaks are not a simultaneous cluster peak.

Full48 parent/child joins identify observed producer commitments. Finalized membership is based on independently checked slot/count census, not reconstructed certificates. Missing or ambiguous joins remain excluded.

Ready spacing is an observed block-event interval, not source transaction latency. Cross-host times are signed wall-clock differences and retain clock offset. Same-host native-ready observations include coordinator pickup.

Coordinator and native phase intervals are wall time. Worker work, async journal ACK waits and restricted stream service can overlap or nest. Per-stage medians and parallel-worker wall sums must not be added into a critical path.

Ledger write_sync is a database-call wall interval, not a measured fsync syscall. Logged0-us mutex wait means below integer-microsecond observation precision. Ledger logical payload bytes are not physical writes.

Inbound byte-budget waits sum overlapping tasks; they are not exclusive elapsed time or proof of a network bottleneck. Retained DATA endpoints may include retransmissions after reconstruction; last observed DATA is not last required DATA.
Raw current PQ transaction wire sizes were not measured in complete receipt metadata and remain null. Serialized block payload bytes and physical host network rates are separate measured quantities.

The run used a fixed committee and a fresh finite18000-slot Ax epoch. Rolling rekey/epochs, broad production compatibility and independent cryptographic assurance are separate work. Default proposal/execution caps were retained.

The duplicate_execution_count status field is literal0, not an empirical execution census. Exact frozen-Bank promotion is supported by source contracts and regression tests; repeated verification calls can hit the pre-existing exact positive Falcon math cache. Main30 adds a separate one-entry canonical parse cache.

Earlier Q27 hour remains rejected with952 undrained source IDs. R30 changes were bundled and the hour offer was halved from Q27; this run does not isolate the cause of the improvement. No uniform efficiency gain or aggregate resource saturation is established.
Ordinary same-binary600-second reference is separately accepted with full audits and cleanup. Its16k offer matches the matched short, not the8k hour.
Rate labels16k/32k/8k in the R-only plots are configured targets. PQ source admission is bounded and backpressured; admitted/requested-offer-second is separate from drain-inclusive TPS.
